title: Decide whether [evidence.commands] may run at absorption decision time, not only at close-out
description: From gvc finding 4292ac06 (npq). pzp makes running an acceptance item the authoritative verdict, but [evidence.commands] are authorised only for close-out today, so an item bound to an evidence command cannot be run when a finding is being decided mid-run. Decide the rule (and its authorisation boundary) and implement it; also decide whether absorbing a finding the final review reported re-buys that review (gvc finding 62700e49).
acceptance_criteria: The rule for running evidence commands at absorption time is written in runners-config and enforced; the review re-buy question is decided and recorded; tests cover the chosen behaviour
